en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a stone fortress complex on a hill. It shows thick defensive walls, a sloped cobblestone road leading through an arched gate, and several stone and plaster buildings with tiled roofs. In the foreground are railings and a low wall, while terraces and rocky outcrops rise toward the ramparts above. Printed caption text in a Scandinavian-style font appears at the top right.
